name: backend-crm-callback-module
observations: project_id: backend-crm
Module: CallbackModule — handles all inbound external webhooks
Base endpoint: POST /api/v1/callbacks/:source — public, no JWT
Auth method: HMAC-SHA256 signature on request body, verified via X-Callback-Signature header
Per-source secrets in env: CALLBACK_SECRET_ERP, CALLBACK_SECRET_CPAY, CALLBACK_SECRET_BILLING
Supported sources: ERP | CPAY | BILLING — validated via enum/constant, unknown source returns 400
Callback payload: { externalRef?: string, customerId: string, visitId?: string, noHp?: string, source: string, metadata?: object }
Lookup priority: visitId (direct) -> noHp (fallback search) -> 404 if not found
Processing flow: verify HMAC -> resolve Visit -> upsert CustomerExternalId -> emit internal event -> return 200
Internal events emitted after callback: visit.customerIdAssigned (consumed by CpayModule, AnalyticsModule)
Strategy pattern: each source (ERP, CPAY, BILLING) has its own CallbackStrategy class — easy to add new sources

name: backend-crm-customer-id-contract
observations: project_id: backend-crm
CustomerExternalId: visitId + source + customerId. @@unique([visitId, source]) — enforced at DB level
source values are CONSTANTS not free text: ERP | CPAY | BILLING
ERP customerId = canonical cross-system customer identifier for pre-customers/prospects
Immutability rule: once set by callback, customerId for a given visitId+source cannot be overwritten by another callback — system returns 409 Conflict
Conflict is AuditLogged: entityType=VISIT, entityId=visitId, action=CALLBACK_CUSTOMER_ID_CONFLICT, metadata includes attempted customerId vs existing
Admin override only: PATCH /api/v1/admin/visits/:id/external-ids/:source (ADMIN role) — also AuditLogged with action=CUSTOMER_ID_ADMIN_OVERRIDE
Read endpoint: GET /api/v1/admin/visits/:id/external-ids — returns all external IDs for a visit across all sources
User scope can read own: GET /api/v1/visits/:id includes externalIds[] in response body
